verificationSummary: Editor commit e67a67f8c7dfa703ada43428a366d0db56bd4393 defines the tested text-block authoring boundary before visible typing UI. It adds src/editor/draft/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.ts, src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts, and docs/TEXT_BLOCK_AUTHORING_BOUNDARY.md. The boundary keeps the current package 3/document 4 rich-inline path intent-only, requires a fresh Core envelope and text-block surface, blocks active text-block island entry until an explicit gate is approved, blocks unsafe DOM-editable binding, blocks active IME composition during draft commit, requires a local draft buffer before commit, and preserves the canonical commit path: editor-intent -> backend-mutation-request -> backend-revision-gate -> core-mutation-result -> editor-stale-gated-runtime-apply. The first RED exposed a syntax error in the new test and was corrected; the accepted RED then failed because ../editor/draft/textBlockAuthoringBoundary was missing. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts with 2 test files and 8 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 91 test files with 316 tests, and build; merged Editor main npm run check passed the same gate. During cleanup, git worktree remove deregistered the short sibling Editor worktree and the feature branch was deleted, but Windows reported Filename too long and left C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-editor-tb-20260830 on disk. That cleanup also caused Core tracked deletions under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm through dependency links; the Core path was restored from HEAD, Core status returned clean, and Core npm run check passed 460 test files with 2,945 tests. No manual residual-folder delete was attempted after the repeat link risk. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG, text input UI, contenteditable runtime, field-chip input, rich-inline flattening, collaboration, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm ci reported 5 existing high severity audit findings and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; neither was remediated in this lane.
